narrative.overview: A monochrome page with exactly one soft, grainy light and one working instrument: a dot-matrix voice field that resolves speech into words, on the Mac, offline. Black, white and graphite carry everything; ember orange appears only where something is live. Display type is Hanken Grotesk light and regular with tight tracking; Fragment Mono keeps machine voice small. Surfaces are white panels with generous radii on a cool off-white ground; buttons and tags are pills. The same world runs in Operate mode for the app mockups; the real app in Sources/Wffl has not been redesigned.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome by default; one accent (ember), one light (the glow), one instrument (the dot field).
Light-weight display type and light large numerals; weight 400 is the heaviest display weight.
Pills for every button and tag; 24px to 32px panels; 14px inner surfaces.
Soft ambient shadows only; depth from white-on-grey tonal layering.
Motion that resolves and reveals once; everything honors reduced motion.

rules.name: The Ember Means Live Rule
rules.body: Ember marks something that is live, moving or located (recording lamp, playhead, scroll progress, today, a match). If a state is not live, it is ink, grey or hollow.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: One soft glow per section, blurred 50px to 80px and grained, always behind or beside a large element and never behind text smaller than a headline.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Border Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px ink-alpha hairline or a tonal step from grey ground to white surface; never a heavy outline.

rules.name: The Mono Is Captions Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono carries only captions, timecodes, speaker labels, dates and status words, at 11 to 12px.

rules.name: The Light Numeral Rule
rules.body: Large numbers are weight 300 with tabular figures and tight tracking.

rules.name: The Glow Plus Grain Rule
rules.body: The glow is a blurred stack of lavender, ember and peach radial gradients always paired with the grain overlay.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are wide, low-opacity and ambient. If a shadow has a visible edge, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Anything clickable and any short label is a pill. Rectangles with small radii are for content surfaces only.

dos: Do keep pages monochrome and let ember appear only for live state (The Ember Means Live Rule).
Do place one glow with grain per section, beside or behind a large element (The One Light Rule).
Do make every button and tag a pill, and every content panel 20px to 32px.
Do set display type at weight 300 to 400 with negative tracking, and large numerals at 300 with tabular figures.
Do keep Fragment Mono for captions, timecodes, speaker labels, dates and status words at 11 to 12px.
Do label sample content as sample, and drive state changes with words as well as colour.
Do ship every animated moment with a reduced-motion fallback that shows the end state.
Do in Operate surfaces, use #F2F2F0 working surface, #E9E9E6 sidebar, black pill for the selected row and primary action.
donts: Don't put ember on buttons, headings, body text or decoration.
Don't place a glow behind text smaller than a headline, or stack two glows in one viewport.
Don't use bold display weights, system display faces, or hard offset shadows.
Don't use a second accent colour; lavender and peach exist only inside the glow.
Don't use the departures-poster language it replaced: yellow blocks, Archivo, square-cornered tiles.
Don't describe the app in Sources/Wffl as having this look until it is actually built.
